title: Illustration / Characters / Eye mistakes
slide_intent: Keep facial features readable because the viewer relies on eyes to recognize a character’s emotional state.
strategic_value: Consistent eye construction can preserve the expressive quality of Duolingo characters across drawings.
demonstration: Three crossed-out face examples compare small glasses, vertically centered pupils and insufficiently rounded eye forms.
practical_value: Check eye construction against the source’s three prohibited treatments.

content_islands.name: Rejected examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange the three face details in a pale panel at left, each inside a pink crossed-out frame.

content_islands.name: Reasons and limits
content_islands.spec: List the three eye prohibitions beneath the Eyes label at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The first prohibition explains that small glasses hide eye emotions.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page prohibits small glasses, vertically centered pupils and eye shapes other than fully rounded pills.

ingredient.name: Character eyes
ingredient.role: Carry emotion clearly within a simple face.
ingredient.application: Use fully rounded pill forms, avoid vertically centered pupils and do not hide eyes with small glasses.
ingredient.scope: Historical character-construction guidance; this page’s restrictions accompany the eye-style options elsewhere in the guide.
